mapper.select: select member_id, business_registration_img_url as document_url, application_status as status, applied_at as created_at, approved_by as reviewed_by, approved_at as reviewed_at from business_application where member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: update business_application set business_registration_img_url = #{documentUrl}, application_status = 'PENDING', applied_at = now(), approved_by = null, approved_at = null where member_id = #{memberId} and application_status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.select: select place_id, member_id, region_id, place_type, name, description, address, is_closed, first_image, hashtags, min_price from PLACE where member_id = #{memberId} order by created_at desc
select image_id, place_id, image_url, sort_order from PLACE_IMAGE where place_id = #{placeId} order by sort_order, image_id
